# A hung task does not trigger the watchdog

The watchdog is fed by its own task, so a hang in another task leaves the camera frozen.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Faults reset the camera in about a second, but a task waiting forever does not. Plan for a battery pull in any test that could block a task.

> **What happens:** Frozen camera that needs a battery pull.

**Symptoms:** [Freezes until the battery is pulled](index.md#freeze)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Watchdog kick task and reset path read from the code. Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): One E-M5 III test build hung without resetting and needed a battery pull. Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
